title: Website Announcement Bar
content:
## Website Announcement Bar


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000045200

Add a notification bar with an announcement message to the top of your website to promote deals, news and more.

The Website Announcement Bar add-on gives you the ability to draw attention to an important message you want to share with your website visitors. A call-to-action button can also be included in the announcement bar to link users to a specific page.

```
How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Website Announcement Bar Add-On
```


## Website Announcement Bar


This article reviews the available settings to edit the Website Announcement Bar. Once this add-on is active, to edit the settings, navigate to:

- Go to: Settings

- Design Settings

- Website Announcement Message


## Visual Guide of the Website Announcement Bar Settings



### 1. Display


Disable this functionality completely (default).

Always display this to visitors and logged in members.

Display only for visitors, logged in members will not see it.

Display only for members, will not show it to visitor.


### 2. Show Close Button


This setting controls whether the Announcement Bar is always displayed or includes a close button. For example, if the Announcement Bar announces a 20% discount, users who have used the discount can close the bar.


### 3. Background Color


This setting controls the background color for the announcement message bar


### 4. Text Color


This setting controls the text color for the announcement message bar


### 5. Font Family


This setting controls the font family for the announcement message bar


### 6. Font Size


This setting controls the font size for the announcement message bar


### 7. Text Position


This setting controls the location of the text for the announcement message bar


### 8. Hide on Mobile


This setting controls if the bar is hidden or viewable on mobile devices.


### 9. Announcement Message


This is the field to write the message that will show up on the announcement bar.It's possible to get very creative with this, it will accept HTML to give the admin more options to personalize this further.


### 10. Link URL


This is the field to write the URL for the link that will show up on the announcement bar


### 11. Link Text


This is the field to write the text for the link that will show up on the announcement bar


### 12. Open link in new tab?


This setting will open the link in a new tab or not.


### 13. Link Text Size


This setting will set the text size for the link of the announcement bar.


### 14. Link Text Color


This setting will set the text color for the link of the announcement bar.


### 15. Link Background Color


This setting will set the background color for the link of the announcement bar.
